title: Why You See Flashes When You Rub Your Eyes
hook: Your eyes can see light, even in complete darkness.

narration.text: Your eyes can see light, even in complete darkness.
This happens when you gently press on your eyelids.
The pressure activates cells in your retina.
These cells send signals to your brain.
Your brain interprets these signals as flashes of light.
It is not actual light, but a trick of your perception.
Comment if you saw the flashes, like if this surprised you, and subscribe for more insights into your amazing body.

description: Ever wondered why you sometimes see flashes of light when you rub your eyes? It is not actual light, but a fascinating quirk of your visual system. Discover the surprising reason behind this common experience.
topic: Why you sometimes see a flash of light when you rub your eyes. You can test this right now by gently pressing on your eyelids.
